technique_name: Given the input context, generate a short passage in the style of the author.
description: The family sat in their living room, their faces illuminated by the dim light from the nearby streetlamp. A silence hung in the air, as though the entire room was holding its breath. The father's face was set in a stern expression as he glared at his son, and the son felt the weight of his gaze. He knew that he was about to hear words that would change his life, words that would challenge his understanding of the world and force him to confront his own privilege. He was determined to listen open
example: Context: An American Novel by James Baldwin
